instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and halve Brussels sprouts. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Drizzle the sprouts with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
⅛ tsp salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until the sprouts begin to brown, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop pecans. Place in a small bowl along with maple syrup. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup pecan halves
3 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: When the sprouts are brown, remove from oven. Top with pecans and maple syrup, then toss to combine.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until sprouts are fork-tender and caramelized, 12-15 minutes more. Remove from oven.
